limitations: Verdict applies only to the exact nine R25 source deltas versus R19, under authority.json; it is not whole-source, historical, CodeQL, deployment, production or release approval.

R25 supplies input-manifest.json, gitleaks.json=[] and a no-leaks log with matching byte count, but no producer argv, effective config or config hash, tool version/binary hash, environment overrides, ignore/baseline provenance, or numeric exit status. Original strict configuration cannot be reconstructed from those files. Fresh independent explicit-config scan supplies security-delta evidence without attributing that configuration to the producer.

Gitleaks default rules and their built-in allowlists remain upstream behavior. No custom rules/allowlists, repository config, baseline, enabled-rule restriction or gitleaks:allow suppression was used. No exact-nine path was skipped. A source scanner and positive control do not establish absence of all possible secrets or dependency vulnerabilities.
Copied TypeScript 6.0.3, semver 7.7.4 and zod 4.3.6 from readonly R19 were used as trusted installed tooling. No dependency installation, advisory lookup or supply-chain approval was performed.

The three added Vitest files and the one changed HISO test were inspected and syntax checked; the original Vitest/native certification/full HISO suites were not run. Independently authored probes ran against owned physical copies of the actual changed modules and their unchanged R19 direct helpers.

Checker-exhaustion and resolver/syntax-worker timeout, output-budget and malformed-output cases were injected faults, not induced production hangs or real OS resource exhaustion. OSC timings and the 32-actor cycle are measured finite samples, not guarantees for arbitrary repository/AST/log sizes.
Scope is the existing module-reference/dynamic-acquisition contract. The checker is a static gate, not a general hostile-JavaScript sandbox or proof over every possible JavaScript runtime behavior.

Fixture payloads remained inert text; only trusted analyzer/parser code, Node resolution and Node --check ran. No default Root governance, prior critic judgments, private env/key content, network/provider/PG, installs, subagents, source writes or R25-chain process control were used. The R25 chain and its descendants were not inspected or operated.

Existing immutable-baseline scanner observations are outside this delta and were not adjudicated. Readonly helpers and the four catalog-referenced R19 files were inspected only to connect changed behavior and validate exact finite hash corrections.
